title: A link through a shared study

sentences.text: The route starts with SLC6A1-related disorders and leads to Simons Searchlight, an online study that includes people with these disorders.
Simons Searchlight also includes people with STXBP1-related disorders, bringing the route to its endpoint.
Both steps are supported by a checked database record, with confidence scores of 0.9.
A route is only as strong as its weakest step.
The input lists the SLC6A1-to-study link as the weakest step, although both steps have the same confidence score.
